body.label: Target
body.html: Self and an optional adjacent willing ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Move up to 2 units, or swap places with the ally. Gain +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn, but your next Cunning Action must target an enemy within 3 units or lose this benefit.

surges.html: The ally may move 1 unit after the swap.
Suppress one ordinary concealment penalty on your next Cunning Action until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Gambit
rider.html: When an enemy declares a melee attack against you before your next turn, move 1 unit and make it Exposed. Recheck its target validity afterward.
